description: Change the cook's own public profile at befana.app/cook/<handle>: handle, display name, about me, location, cooking interests, up to three links, and whether the photo and about me show (show_details; off until the cook turns it on). Before calling, tell the cook exactly what will change and get a clear yes; set cook_confirmed only then. Pass only the fields to change; interests and links replace the saved list. A changed handle keeps the old one redirecting for 90 days. A photo is uploaded on the website (Settings → Your public profile); photo: "google" copies the cook's Google account photo, photo: null removes it. Never write about-me text for the cook: only what they said.

about.description: Up to 300 characters, in the cook's words; null clears it

cook_confirmed.description: True only after the cook said yes to this exact change

handle.description: 3 to 30 letters, digits or underscores; reserved words are refused

interests.description: Cooking interests, up to 10; replaces the list

links.description: Up to 3; an Instagram, TikTok, YouTube or Substack link must be on that site; replaces the list

location.description: As the cook says it, e.g. "Denver"; null clears it

photo.description: "google" copies the account's Google photo (processed and stored by Befana); null removes the photo

show_details.description: True shows the photo, about me, location, interests and links on the public page

name: update_profile
title: Change the cook's public profile
